content: 1. A guide to statistical methods for evaluating the impact of programs is available online and was accessed on May 2, 2016. 2. Peters DH, Adam T, Alonge O, Agyepong IA, and Tran N have published a detailed explanation of implementation research, including its definition and methodology, in the BMJ journal in 2013 (volume 347, article f6753). 3. A comprehensive resource on monitoring and evaluation tools, methods, and approaches was published by The International Bank for Reconstruction and Development/The World Bank in Washington, DC, in 2004. 4. The MAPS Toolkit, which focuses on mHealth Assessment and Planning for Scale, was published by the World Health Organization in Geneva in 2015. 5. Song JW and Chung KC provided an in-depth discussion on observational studies, specifically cohort and case-control studies, in the journal Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery in 2010 (volume 126, issue 6, pages 2234–2242). 6. A glossary of selected terms related to planning, monitoring, and evaluation is available online and was accessed on May 4, 2016. 7. Peters D, Tran N, and Adam T authored a practical guide on implementation research in health, published by the Alliance for Health Policy and Systems Research, World Health Organization, in Geneva in 2013. 8. Israel BA, Schulz AJ, Parker EA, Becker AB, Allen AJ III, and Guzman RJ contributed to a chapter on community-based participatory research (CBPR) for health, focusing on processes and outcomes, in the second edition of Critical Issues in Developing and Following CBPR Principles, edited by Minkler M and Wallerstein N, and published by Wiley in 2010. 9. Smith L, Rosenzweig L, and Schmidt M outlined best practices for reporting participatory action research, emphasizing both broad and detailed perspectives, in The Counseling Psychologist in 2010 (volume 38, issue 8, pages 1115–1138). 10. A detailed explanation of probability sampling is available in the Research Methods Knowledge Base website, accessed on May 6, 2016. 11. Reeves CA and Bednar DA explored the concept of quality, its alternatives, and implications in the Academy of Management Review. This resource was accessed on April 11, 2016. 12. A guide titled Performance Monitoring and Evaluation Tips: Building a Results Framework is available online and was accessed on May 6, 2016. 13. Bryson JM, Patton MQ, and Bowman RA developed a rationale, step-by-step approach, and toolkit for working with evaluation stakeholders, published in Evaluation and Program Planning in 2011 (volume 34, issue 1, pages 1–12). 14. Vogel I conducted a review of the use of the Theory of Change in international development, which is available online and was accessed on May 6, 2016. 15. Usability standards are discussed in the ISO 25000 software product quality guidelines, which were accessed on May 9, 2016. 16. Use cases are detailed on a government website, which was accessed on April 11, 2016. 17. A guide on crafting a value proposition is available on the MaRS website and was accessed on March 21, 2016. 18. Wireframing resources are available on a government website, accessed on April 11, 2016.
